text: ねえ　シゲ…　わたし　ずっと　まってるのよ　もし　かてたら　けっこん　して　あげる！

structure.jp: わたし　ずっと　まってるのよ
structure.en: I've been waiting all this time, you know

structure.jp: けっこん　して　あげる！

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'once that happens'. かてる is 'can win', so もし　かてたら = 'if you can win'.

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-verb means doing something as a favor for someone. けっこん　して　あげる = 'I'll marry you (as a favor to you)'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says an action is going on right now or has been going on. まってる is the short spoken form of まっている. ずっと　まってる = 'I have been waiting all this time'.
